name: rasa.io
description_en:
rasa.io combines curated content, subscriber-level article selection and email distribution. Its recurring newsletter chooses articles within an editor’s sources, sections and limits. The current commercial site addresses associations and broader member communications, with Sequences and Blasts documented as additional message types.

For an association digest, the important work is choosing the eligible pool and deciding which announcements everyone must receive. Personalization does not remove source review, scheduling or access checks. This profile examines those controls and the current quotation model without adopting vendor engagement gains as independently verified results.
description_zh:
rasa.io 将内容策选、订阅者层面的文章选择及邮件分发结合。定期简报在编辑设定的来源、栏目及限制中选文章。当前商业官网面向协会及更广泛的会员沟通，文档将 Sequences 和 Blasts 列为附加消息类型。

协会摘要的关键工作，是选择合格内容池并决定哪些通知必须让所有人收到。个性化不能取代来源审核、排程或访问检查。本文检查这些控制及当前报价模式，未将厂商互动提升宣传视为独立验证结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Use topic, source and engagement signals within editorial constraints.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在编辑约束内使用主题、来源及互动信号。

core_features.explanation_en: Curate feeds and individual articles with filters and active states.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过筛选与活跃状态管理来源及单篇文章。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate eligible articles from deliberately prioritized or dated content.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分可选文章、明确优先文章及按日期安排的内容。

core_features.explanation_en: Evaluate drip messages separately from an identical-content broadcast.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分别评估滴灌消息与内容一致的群发。

en: Produce a recurring association digest from reviewed content sources.
Combine personalized reading recommendations with separately controlled common notices.
zh: 根据已审核来源制作协会定期摘要。
将个性化阅读推荐与单独控制的共同通知结合。

sections.title_en: Build a pool before asking AI to select articles
sections.title_zh: 先建立内容池，再让 AI 选文章
sections.en:
For an illustrative association digest, an editor might combine its own updates, an industry feed and a podcast. The Sources guide supports feeds, video/social sources and topic discovery. LinkedIn ingestion requires an account with administration access to the organization’s page; it is not a general reader for arbitrary profiles.

Source-level and newsletter-level filters both apply at selection. An article must pass both. When a source stops producing, check its active state, refresh result, feed availability and last-checked timestamp. A scheduled digest cannot draw fresh material from a broken feed merely because the source remains listed.
sections.zh:
例如协会摘要，编辑可结合本机构动态、行业订阅源及播客。Sources 指南支持订阅源、视频／社交来源及主题发现。LinkedIn 导入需要管理本机构页面的账户，并非任意个人主页阅读器。

来源级与简报级筛选都在选文时生效，文章须同时通过。来源停止产出时，应检查活跃状态、刷新结果、订阅源可用性及最后检查时间。来源仍被列出，不代表排定摘要能从失效订阅源获取新内容。

sections.title_en: Eligible content and mandatory notices are different
sections.title_zh: 可选内容与必达通知不同
sections.en:
Adding an article to the Content Pool only makes it eligible. Featuring is section-specific and must be saved. The curation guide describes featured ordering as editorial, while the personalization guide says featured items may be ranked differently per subscriber and remain subject to article-count settings. Do not infer a guaranteed universal order from these mixed descriptions.

For a renewal deadline that needs consistent wording and placement, investigate the scheduled-content controls or an identical-content Blast. Feature an entire source cautiously: the documentation says all its articles become featured. The editorial decision affects every future pool contribution from that source.
sections.zh:
将文章加入内容池，只意味着它可被选中。推荐操作针对栏目，且必须保存。策选指南称推荐顺序由编辑设置，个性化指南却说推荐项可能按订阅者重新排序，并受文章数量限制。不能据此推断全体一致顺序保证。

续费截止等需要一致措辞及位置的通知，应核查排程内容控制或内容一致的 Blast。推荐整个来源需谨慎：文档称其全部文章会被推荐，这会影响该来源后续内容池贡献。

sections.title_en: Enough active articles is a sending prerequisite
sections.title_zh: 足够活跃文章是生成前提
sections.en:
The curation guide gives newsletters minimum and maximum article counts and a per-source maximum. If the active pool cannot meet the minimum, the newsletter does not generate. Near the scheduled time, automatic pulling stops for a cutoff window, typically around four hours; manual additions and edits remain possible.

Set the threshold around the real publishing cadence, then inspect the pool before cutoff. A one-off addition is not the same as scheduled guaranteed placement. For an urgent late announcement, verify the generated content instead of assuming that a newly published feed article was ingested in time.
sections.zh:
策选指南提供文章最少、最多及每来源上限。活跃内容池无法满足最少数量时，简报不会生成。接近排定时间时会停止自动抓取，通常约提前四小时；仍可手动添加和编辑。

应按真实发布频率设置门槛，并在截止窗口前检查内容池。单次添加不等于排程保证位置。紧急临近通知需检查已生成内容，不能假设刚发布的订阅源文章已及时导入。

sections.title_en: Personalization has a cold start and a language boundary
sections.title_zh: 个性化存在冷启动及语言边界
sections.en:
The personalization guide says new subscribers initially see more generic content until engagement supplies signals. It separates editor-controlled sources/filters from AI article choice and ranking; no outcome improvement was measured here.

The language guide lists English, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese for AI content processing. A language must first be enabled for the organization and then selected for the newsletter. That setting does not translate emails, footer text, pages or the UI. Unsupported content can be misclassified or marked inactive. An editor preparing another language should validate ingestion and selection rather than treating the translated catalog profile as product support.
sections.zh:
个性化指南说明，新订阅者缺乏互动信号时最初看到更通用的内容；它区分编辑控制的来源／筛选与 AI 的文章选择及排序。本文未测量效果提升。

语言指南列出英语、西班牙语、法语、德语及葡萄牙语用于 AI 内容处理。需先在机构启用，再在简报选择。该设置不会翻译邮件、页脚、页面或界面。不支持的内容可能误分类或被设为不活跃。准备其他语言时，应验证导入和选文，不能将目录中文稿当作产品语言支持。

sections.title_en: A representative preview cannot prove every member’s experience
sections.title_zh: 代表性预览不能证明每位会员体验
sections.en:
Preview requires an attached audience list and enough active articles. Test emails use sample personalization, so they are representative rather than exact copies of every subscriber’s newsletter. Review links, sender details, unsubscribe behavior and rendering using controlled test addresses.

The paywall guide says there is no universal indicator for gated articles: access depends on a reader’s subscriptions and prior visits. A working link for the editor may still require another member to sign in or pay. Label known gated sources and evaluate whether the intended audience can use them; successful ingestion is not evidence of universal reading access.
sections.zh:
预览需要已关联受众列表及足够活跃文章。测试邮件使用样本个性化，因此具有代表性，但不是每位订阅者简报的精确副本。应以受控测试地址检查链接、发送者、退订及显示。

付费墙指南称不存在通用门控标识，访问取决于读者订阅及既往访问。编辑可打开的链接，另一会员仍可能需登录或付费。应标注已知门控来源并评估受众是否可用；成功导入不能证明所有人可阅读全文。

sections.title_en: Use the message type that matches the consistency requirement
sections.title_zh: 按一致性要求选择消息类型
sections.en:
Newsletters are the core personalized recurring format. Sequences provide a series over time and can also use article personalization. Blasts send one-time identical content while sharing audience management and reporting. The overview asks users to contact support to add Sequences or Blasts; their existence in the product family does not establish inclusion in a specific contract.

rasa.io merits evaluation for an association with recurring curated material and someone accountable for content eligibility and audience access. It may add unnecessary curation work when the only requirement is an occasional identical announcement. Check message-type entitlement and complete a controlled send before adopting it.
sections.zh:
Newsletters 是核心的个性化定期格式。Sequences 按时间发送系列，也可使用文章个性化。Blasts 单次发送一致内容，同时共享受众管理和报告。概览要求联系支持增加 Sequences 或 Blasts；产品家族具备，不代表具体合同已包含。

有持续策选素材、且有人负责内容资格与受众访问的协会，可评估 rasa.io。如果只需偶尔发送相同通知，额外策选工作可能不必要。采用前需确认消息类型权限并完成受控发送。

sections.title_en: Current pricing needs an organizational scope
sections.title_zh: 当前价格需要机构范围信息
sections.en:
The current price page uses association annual revenue, participating departments, newsletter use and scope. It states no per-contact or integration fee, an annual contract rate with a minimum platform commitment, and a one-time setup fee covering configuration, sources and templates. Custom reporting and data strategy can affect scope.

The unselected calculator displays zero and a dash for setup, so these are not quoted as a free plan. Obtain a completed organizational quote with the intended message types, reporting and onboarding work. No checkout, contract, account entitlement, source license or self-hosting right was inspected.
sections.zh:
当前价格页依据协会年收入、使用部门、简报使用及范围。它声明不按联系人或集成收费，年度合同有最低平台承诺，并收取一次性设置费，涵盖配置、来源及模板。定制报告和数据策略也影响范围。

未选择的计算器显示零，设置费为横线，因此不能作为免费套餐报价。需按预期消息类型、报告及入门工作获取完整机构报价。本文未检查结算、合同、账户权限、源码许可或自托管权利。

seo.title_en: rasa.io: Personalized Association Newsletters, Content Controls and Pricing
seo.title_zh: rasa.io：个性化协会简报、内容控制及价格
seo.description_en: Understand rasa.io content pools, source filters, generation limits, sample previews and the current organizational quote model.
seo.description_zh: 了解 rasa.io 内容池、来源筛选、生成限制、样本预览及当前机构报价模式。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate rasa.io for a curated association digest with controlled common announcements.
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Featured-content ordering is described differently across curation and personalization guides. Exact account behavior, quote and message-type entitlements require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 策选与个性化指南对推荐内容排序表述不同；实际账户行为、报价及消息类型权限需确认。

research_gaps.en: No source ingestion, newsletter, test email, integration or audience operation was executed. UI languages, regional eligibility, contract data location, licensing and deployment rights remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行来源导入、简报、测试邮件、集成或受众操作。界面语言、地区资格、合同数据位置、许可及部署权利仍未核实。
